items.title: The cost of leaving an honest answer unrevisited
items.description: Using the same illustrative point system as L3 (each day a real decision sits unaddressed after the honest Day 3 answer adds risk points, up to a maximum of 100), drag the number of days between the ask and Sam's actual decision deadline to see how risk builds. At 9 days (Priya's actual gap, Day 3 to Day 12) and 7 points per day, this reproduces a risk of 63 — already high, well before Day 14's announcement.
